title: The Lock Call: Thursday, November 26
blurb: Thanksgiving gas is $3.56, Merv grades the president's under-two-dollars ticket, and Brett and Edwin take opposite sides in San Antonio.

lines.text: [bright] Happy Thanksgiving! Gas is three fifty-six, and somebody told us under two.
[grinning] And Edwin and I split one game. Eight picks. Go!
From The Window at Hardwood Bricks, this is Tops and Bottoms, the Lock Call. I'm Brett Busberger.
And I'm Leslie Phyllis. Happy Thanksgiving. Triple A has gas at three fifty-six a gallon this morning. Down seventy-three cents in a month.
Good news. But in September, the president said that after the election, we'd get it below two dollars.
[dry] Young man, he took the under at two. It closed at three fifty-six. That ticket is dead.
[wheezing] I've had worse beats. Don't ask.
Today's picks. The under, one thirty-nine and a half, Pacific and Omaha. And U C Davis, plus two against Jacksonville State.
And the machine has Jacksonville State, laying two. Sorry, Merv. Also Army, plus twelve and a half at U T S A.
[out of breath] Sorry, kid. U T S A, laying twelve and a half. And the over, one forty-nine and a half. The shrimp at the Neptune Lounge came in on the wrong truck. You didn't hear it from me.
I'm keeping it in one game. Saint Mary's and U C L A. Over one fifty-two and a half, and Saint Mary's, plus seven and a half.
The board. Everybody split. The house went four and four.
Still on top. Nine, four and one, up four point one nine units.
I'm second, nine and five. Brett's eight, five and one. And Edwin is six and eight.
[proud] Six wins. That goes on the list.
That's the Lock Call. The picks column is up now at hardwood bricks dot com. Happy Thanksgiving. Pass the stuffing.
Twenty-one and up. If gambling's a problem, call one eight hundred GAMBLER.
Keep it mid. Keep it real.

news.item: AAA national average for regular gasoline was $3.5554 on Nov 26, 2026 (month ago $4.2858, year ago $3.0416). In September the president said: "Right after the election, oil prices are going to be tumbling downward ... I think for gasoline, we'll get them below $2 a gallon" (as quoted by the Daily Wire, Nov 10; AP carries the first half). The 'dead ticket' line is the gang's opinion.

notes.board: Standings through Nov 25; yesterday = Nov 25 card (house 4-4).
